tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE payment_idempotency_records(organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(idempotency_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 255),operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(operation IN('record_payment','reverse_payment')),fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(fingerprint)=71 AND substr(fingerprint,1,7)='sha256:' AND substr(fingerprint,8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),result_id TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(organization_id,idempotency_key),FOREIGN KEY(result_id)REFERENCES invoice_payments(id))STRICT

tables.name: product_presets

checks.expression: unit_price NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*' AND unit_price GLOB '[0-9]*.[0-9][0-9]' AND length(unit_price)-length(replace(unit_price,'.',''))=1
preferred_vat_rate_code IS NULL OR length(preferred_vat_rate_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 32

tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE product_presets(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,description TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(description))>0),unit_price TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(unit_price NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*' AND unit_price GLOB '[0-9]*.[0-9][0-9]' AND length(unit_price)-length(replace(unit_price,'.',''))=1), unit_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(unit_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 3), unit_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(unit_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),preferred_vat_rate_code TEXT CHECK(preferred_vat_rate_code IS NULL OR length(preferred_vat_rate_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 32),UNIQUE(organization_id,id))STRICT

tables.name: proforma_conversions
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE proforma_conversions(proforma_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,resulting_draft_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,converted_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,proforma_id)REFERENCES proformas(organization_id,id),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,resulting_draft_id)REFERENCES invoice_drafts(organization_id,id))STRICT

tables.name: proforma_invoice_conversions
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE proforma_invoice_conversions(proforma_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,resulting_invoice_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,converted_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,proforma_id)REFERENCES proformas(organization_id,id),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,resulting_invoice_id)REFERENCES issued_invoices(organization_id,id))STRICT

checks.expression: (tax_code='RO_STANDARD' AND tax_rate IN('19.00','21.00') AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED' AND tax_rate IN('9.00','11.00') AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED_5' AND tax_rate='5.00' AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_NON_VAT' AND tax_rate='0.00' AND tax_category='O' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NOT NULL AND vat_exemption_reason='Regim special de scutire conform art. 310 din Codul fiscal')

tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE proforma_lines(id TEXT NOT NULL,proforma_id TEXT NOT NULL,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,line_position INTEGER NOT NULL,description TEXT NOT NULL,quantity TEXT NOT NULL,unit_price TEXT NOT NULL,tax_code TEXT NOT NULL,tax_category TEXT NOT NULL,tax_rate TEXT NOT NULL,vat_exemption_reason TEXT,total_excluding_tax TEXT NOT NULL,tax_amount TEXT NOT NULL,total_including_tax TEXT NOT NULL,unit_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(unit_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 3),unit_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(unit_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),PRIMARY KEY(proforma_id,id),UNIQUE(proforma_id,line_position),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,proforma_id)REFERENCES proformas(organization_id,id),CHECK((tax_code='RO_STANDARD' AND tax_rate IN('19.00','21.00') AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED' AND tax_rate IN('9.00','11.00') AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED_5' AND tax_rate='5.00' AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_NON_VAT' AND tax_rate='0.00' AND tax_category='O' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NOT NULL AND vat_exemption_reason='Regim special de scutire conform art. 310 din Codul fiscal')))STRICT

tables.name: proforma_tax_breakdown

checks.expression: (tax_code='RO_STANDARD' AND rate IN('19.00','21.00') AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED' AND rate IN('9.00','11.00') AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED_5' AND rate='5.00' AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_NON_VAT' AND rate='0.00' AND category='O' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NOT NULL AND vat_exemption_reason='Regim special de scutire conform art. 310 din Codul fiscal')

tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE proforma_tax_breakdown(proforma_id TEXT NOT NULL,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,line_position INTEGER NOT NULL,tax_code TEXT NOT NULL,category TEXT NOT NULL,rate TEXT NOT NULL,vat_exemption_reason TEXT,taxable_amount TEXT NOT NULL,tax_amount TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(proforma_id,line_position),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,proforma_id)REFERENCES proformas(organization_id,id),CHECK((tax_code='RO_STANDARD' AND rate IN('19.00','21.00') AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED' AND rate IN('9.00','11.00') AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED_5' AND rate='5.00' AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_NON_VAT' AND rate='0.00' AND category='O' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NOT NULL AND vat_exemption_reason='Regim special de scutire conform art. 310 din Codul fiscal')))STRICT

tables.name: proformas

checks.expression: notes IS NULL OR(length(notes) BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND trim(notes)=notes)
(issuer_county='RO-B' AND issuer_sector BETWEEN 1 AND 6)OR(issuer_county!='RO-B' AND issuer_sector IS NULL)
(customer_county='RO-B' AND customer_sector BETWEEN 1 AND 6)OR(customer_county!='RO-B' AND customer_sector IS NULL)

CHECK(document_type='proforma'),series TEXT NOT NULL,number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(number>0),issue_date TEXT NOT NULL,due_date TEXT,issued_at TEXT NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(currency='RON'),issuer_legal_name TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_tax_identifier TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_country_code TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_city TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_street TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_county TEXT NOT NULL,customer_country_code TEXT NOT NULL,customer_city TEXT NOT NULL,customer_street TEXT NOT NULL,customer_county TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(customer_county IN('RO-AB','RO-AR','RO-AG','RO-BC','RO-BH','RO-BN','RO-BR','RO-BT','RO-BV','RO-B','RO-BZ','RO-CS','RO-CL','RO-CJ','RO-CT','RO-CV','RO-DB','RO-DJ','RO-GL','RO-GR','RO-GJ','RO-HR','RO-HD','RO-IL','RO-IS','RO-IF','RO-MM','RO-MH','RO-MS','RO-NT','RO-OT','RO-PH','RO-SM','RO-SJ','RO-SB','RO-SV','RO-TR','RO-TM','RO-TL','RO-VS','RO-VL','RO-VN')),customer_sector INTEGER,customer_postal_code TEXT,customer_vat_registered INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(customer_vat_registered IN(0,1)AND(customer_party_type!='individual' OR customer_vat_registered=0)),total_excluding_tax TEXT NOT NULL,tax_total TEXT NOT NULL,total_including_tax TEXT NOT NULL,sealed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(sealed IN(0,1)),source_app TEXT,source_kind TEXT,source_id TEXT,notes TEXT CHECK(notes IS NULL OR(length(notes) BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND trim(notes)=notes)),issuer_branding TEXT CHECK(issuer_branding IS NULL OR json_valid(issuer_branding)),issuer_legal_form TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(issuer_legal_form IN('srl','pfa')),issuer_trade_registry_number TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_iban TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_bank_name TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_social_capital TEXT NOT NULL,actor_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(actor_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255),issuer_vat_registered INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(issuer_vat_registered
